learningObjective: See the direct connection between a ring in the circle and its corresponding strip in the triangle — each ring becomes a horizontal strip with width equal to its circumference
ahaMoment: Each ring in the circle maps directly to a strip in the triangle — the connection is visual and immediate
proposition: A thin ring, when cut and unrolled, becomes a rectangle with width 2πr (the circumference) and height dr (the thickness)

miniSpec.title: Circle and Triangle Side-by-Side
miniSpec.manipulated_variable: Slider below both views or hover to highlight rings
miniSpec.primary_visual_feedback: Highlighted ring on left corresponds to highlighted strip on right simultaneously; the triangle shows all rings stacked with dimensions labeled
miniSpec.causal_chain_exposed: Left panel shows nested colored rings, right panel shows all strips forming triangle with base 2πR and height R labeled, highlighted ring matches highlighted strip
miniSpec.trace_strategy: Current state is sufficient — focus is on the correspondence
miniSpec.aha_moment: Each ring in the circle maps directly to a strip in the triangle — the connection is visual and immediate

interactionContract.student_sees: highlighted ring on left corresponds to highlighted strip on right; the triangle shows all rings stacked

modelVariables.numRings: number of concentric rings the circle is divided into (student-controlled via slider)
modelVariables.R: circle radius — carried over from section 1, frozen at its value
modelVariables.unwrapping_highlightedRing: index of the currently highlighted ring (0-indexed), derived from hover or defaults to middle
modelVariables.unwrapping_highlightedCircumference: derived: circumference of the highlighted ring = 2πr

assertions.description: On load, the split visualization is visible with rings on left and triangle on right, with a middle ring highlighted showing the correspondence
assertions.visualCheck: Circle on left with colored rings, triangle of stacked strips on right, one ring and its corresponding strip are highlighted in accent color

assertions.description: The highlighted ring on the left corresponds to a highlighted strip on the right with matching position
assertions.visualCheck: One ring in the circle is highlighted with accent stroke; the corresponding strip in the triangle is highlighted simultaneously

assertions.description: Increasing the number of rings makes each ring thinner
assertions.visualCheck: Rings become visibly thinner; more strips appear in the triangle, each strip narrower

assertions.description: R is carried over and does not change when numRings changes
assertions.visualCheck: The overall circle size remains constant; only the ring divisions change

invariants.description: Highlighted ring index is always within valid range
